title: Juicy Irish Spinach Pie
description: Peppery, gooey, romantic Irish dish made with ready rolled shortcrust pastry, spinach, mushrooms, and halal mozzarella, wrapped in a banana leaf for extra aroma.
instructions: Lightly heat banana leaf until pliable, cut to 30x20 cm, dust with flour.
In a skillet, heat 1 tbsp olive oil, sauté onion and garlic until translucent, add mushrooms, cook until moisture evaporates.
Add spinach to the skillet, stir until wilted, season with salt, pepper, and herbs blend, remove from heat.
Spread pastry into a 23cm pie dish, trim edges, spoon spinach-mushroom mixture onto pastry.
Beat eggs with double cream, pour over filling, sprinkle shredded mozzarella.
Fold banana leaf over the top, press edges to seal, place dish in oven.
Bake for 25 minutes until pastry golden and cheese bubbly.
Remove, let cool 5 minutes, cut into wedges, serve.
